data.one_liner: Odoo RPC Client library for Dart with session changes tracking via stream.
data.what_it_does: Allows Dart and Flutter apps to connect to Odoo backends, issue JSON-RPC requests, handle authentication, and track session changes via streams.
use_when: You are building a Flutter or Dart application that communicates with an Odoo ERP backend.
You need to track session updates or handle expired sessions.
avoid_when: You are not using Odoo as your backend.
You need a general-purpose REST or GraphQL client without Odoo-specific RPC methods.
strengths: Provides seamless integration with Odoo authentication and session management.
Supports cross-platform environments including mobile, desktop, and web.
weaknesses: Web platform support requires specific CORS configuration on the Odoo server.
Limited strictly to Odoo ERP backend interactions.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and configure CORS headers on the Odoo server if targeting the web platform.
